translations.web: The young men carry millstones. The children stumbled under loads of wood.
translations.bsb: Young men toil at millstones; boys stagger under loads of wood.
translations.kjv: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.
translations.asv: The young men bare the mill; And the children stumbled under the wood.
